tickets.title: Blulectric engine: 3D model, 6-way oriented blockstates and crafting recipe
tickets.description: Construct the 3D block model and 6-directional blockstates for the Blulectric Engine based on original btengine1.obj (engine base), btengine2.obj (sliding piston), and btengine3.obj (crankshaft gear) geometry and /eloraam/compat/compat1.png#0 texture mappings. Configure blockstates for all 6 facings (down, up, north, south, west, east). Register the crafting recipe: 3x brass ingot (top row), 1x glass (center), 2x brass gear (sides), 1x bl_motor (bottom center). Done: block model and blockstates validate against check-mods and match original dimensions.

tickets.title: Blulectric engine: state machine, blutricity consumer node and flywheel MJ calculation
tickets.description: Pure Rust state machine, Blutricity consumer node, flywheel MJ calculation, and contract file in mods/redpower_2/src/compat/engine.rs and planning/mods/redpower_2.contract/blulectric_engine.json. Orient placement to 6 directions (pitch and yaw towards player). Connects to Blutricity power grid as an endpoint consumer: reaches Charged state when voltage >= 60.0V; checks redstone power on neighbor change for Powered state. When Charged and Powered: enters Active state, draws 50W base blutricity power, advances pump stroke cycle (PumpSpeed accelerates from 16 down to 4 ticks per half-stroke), draws up to 32 MJ/tick (1,000 W/MJ) into 512 MJ flywheel. Writes planning/mods/redpower_2.contract/blulectric_engine.json with L1, L3, L4, L5 scenarios. Done: contract-check clean for blulectric_engine; domain unit tests passing.

tickets.title: Blulectric engine: native mixin wiring, sided power delivery and fluid interop
tickets.description: Native mixin wiring in mods/redpower_2/native/mixins/redpower_2/blulectric_engine.rs. Connects Blulectric Engine block and tile entity to Horizon world tick, neighbor updates, and adjacent BuildCraft IPowerReceptor / rekkit_core MjBuffer power delivery at facing^1. Saves and loads flywheel charge, pump speed, and pump tick via NBT ('flyw', 'spd', 'ptk'). Registers BuildCraft oil fluid compatibility with RedPower fluid pipeline. Done: mixin hooks compile cleanly and pass harness wiring checks.

tickets.title: BuildCraft compatibility integration tests: Blulectric engine power conversion and fluid interop
tickets.description: Integration tests for RedPower 2 BuildCraft compatibility: test Blulectric Engine blutricity consumption, charging at 60V threshold, flywheel energy accumulation (up to 512 MJ), kinetic power emission into adjacent MjBuffer at facing^1 on half-stroke pump tick, pump acceleration (from 16 down to 4 ticks), redstone on/off switching, and chunk save/reload persistence.
